chapters.title: One day a boy named Tim…
p: One day, a boy named Tim went to the park. He saw a big slide there. Tim wanted to go down the slide fast. But there was a problem. A big dog was at the bottom of the slide. The dog would not move. Tim was sad.
Tim had an idea. He would bring a toy for the dog to play with. He ran home and got a ball. When he got back to the park, he threw the ball far away. The dog ran fast to get the ball.

Now the slide was free. Tim climbed up and went down the slide very fast. He was so happy. The dog brought the ball back to Tim. They played together and became good friends. Tim learned that sometimes, you just need to think of a good idea to solve a problem.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little brown dog named Spot. Spot loved to play and run in the park. One day, Spot had an idea. He wanted to watch the big red ball in the sky go down.

Spot ran to the park and waited for the big red ball to go down. He saw his friend, a little yellow bird named Tweet. Tweet liked Spot's idea and wanted to watch the big red ball go down too. So, they sat on a green hill and waited.

As they watched, the big red ball started to go down. The sky turned pretty colors like pink, orange, and purple. Spot and Tweet were very happy they saw it together. From that day on, they always met at the park to watch the big red ball go down.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to go to the library with his mom. At the library, he would find many books with fun pictures.
One day, Tim saw a big balloon outside the library. The big balloon would rise up into the sky. Tim wanted to catch the balloon, but it was very high. He was a persistent boy and did not give up.

Tim asked his mom for help. Together, they found a tall ladder. They put the ladder next to the big balloon. Tim climbed up the ladder and caught the balloon. Tim was very happy and shared the balloon with his friends at the library.

chapters.title: Once upon a time in a…
p: Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived an elderly lady. She had many books that she loved to read. Every day, she would sit in her big chair and read her favorite book.
One sunny day, while she was reading, she felt a tickle in her nose. It made her want to sneeze. She tried to hold it in, but she couldn't. "Achoo!" she sneezed, and her book flew out of her hands.

The elderly lady looked around for her book. She found it under the table. She picked it up, wiped her nose, and went back to her big chair. She smiled and started reading her book again. And from that day on, she always had a tissue nearby, just in case she needed to sneeze.

chapters.title: Once upon a time in a…
p: Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big tree in her yard. On this tree, there were many pears. Lily liked to eat the pears from the tree.
One day, Lily saw a very tough pear high up in the tree. She wanted it very much. She tried to climb the tree, but it was too high. She asked her friend, Tom, "Can you help me get the tough pear?"
Tom tried to climb the tree, but he fell down and started to weep. Lily felt sad for Tom. She wanted to help him, but she didn't know how.
In the end, Lily and Tom couldn't get the tough pear. They both went home feeling sad. The tough pear stayed in the tree, and nobody could reach it.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a prince who lived in a big castle. The prince was very kind and loved to help others. One day, the prince decided it was time to gather food for the people in his kingdom.

The prince put on his shoes and got ready to go outside. He walked around the kingdom, picking up apples, bananas, and carrots. As he gathered the food, he saw a little girl who was hungry. The prince shared some of his food with her, and she was very happy.

The people in the kingdom saw the prince helping the little girl and they all wanted to be kind too. They started to gather food and share it with each other. Everyone was happy and full. The prince taught them that when we help others, we make the world a better place.

chapters.title: One day a girl named Sue…
p: One day, a girl named Sue went to the beach with her mom. Sue loved the sand and the water. She played with her toys and built a big sand castle. The sun was warm, and the water was cool. Sue was very happy.

While playing, Sue found a small, soft oyster. She picked it up and showed it to her mom. "Look, Mom, I found an oyster!" Sue said. Her mom smiled and said, "That's a pretty oyster, Sue. Maybe there's a surprise inside. Let's open it later."

Sue put the oyster in her bag and played some more. She swam in the water and played with her friends. The sun began to go down, and it was time to go home. Sue was excited to see what was inside the oyster.

At home, Sue and her mom opened the oyster. Inside, they found a shiny pearl. Sue's eyes lit up with joy. "Wow, Mom, look! We found a pearl!" Her mom said, "That's a beautiful pearl, Sue. It's a special surprise from the oyster."

Sue put the pearl in a small box and kept it in her room. Every day, she looked at the pearl and remembered the fun day at the beach with her mom. The pearl made her very happy, and she knew that the oyster had given her a special gift.

chapters.title: Once upon a time in a…
p: Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom had a big bag of marbles. He liked to play with them all day. One day, Tom saw his friend, Sam, playing with his marbles. Sam had a shiny, green marble. Tom felt envious of Sam's green marble.
Tom said, "Sam, can I play with your green marble?"
Sam said, "Yes, but let's spread our marbles on the ground and play together."

So, Tom and Sam spread their marbles on the ground. They played a fun game, rolling the marbles back and forth. Tom was happy to play with the shiny, green marble, and Sam was happy to share with his friend.
At the end of the day, Tom and Sam picked up their marbles. Sam said, "Tom, you can keep the green marble. We are friends, and friends share."
Tom smiled and said, "Thank you, Sam!" From that day on, Tom and Sam played with their marbles together, and they were the best of friends.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was an ugly sweater. This sweater was not like the others. It was big and had many colors on it. People did not want to wear the ugly sweater.
One day, it was very cold outside. The wind was blowing and everyone started to freeze. They needed something to keep them warm. The ugly sweater saw that the people were cold and wanted to help.

The ugly sweater went to the people and said, "I can keep you warm!" The people were not sure at first, but they were so cold that they decided to try it. They put on the ugly sweater and felt warm and cozy. They were not cold anymore, and they were happy. From that day on, the people loved the ugly sweater and it was not so ugly after all.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a happy dog named Max. Max loved to run and play outside. One day, Max found a trail in the woods. He was very excited to see where it went.
Max walked on the trail and saw many things. He saw big trees, pretty flowers, and little bugs. Max wanted to protect all his new friends in the woods. He barked at the birds to keep them safe.

At the end of the trail, Max found a big lake. He jumped in and splashed around. Max was very happy to find such a fun place. He knew he would come back to the trail and protect his friends every day. And Max lived happily ever after.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little bee. He lived in a hive with his bee friends. Every day, the bees would fly around and find flowers. The flowers had sweet stuff inside. The bees loved the sweet stuff.

One day, the little bee did not want to fly. He wanted to walk like a normal bug. So, he walked out of his hive. He walked on the grass and saw many bugs. He saw ants, and they were walking too. The little bee was happy to walk like them.

As he walked, he found a big flower. It had sweet stuff inside. The little bee walked back to his hive. He told his friends about his walk. The other bees wanted to walk too. So, they all walked together and had fun. The little bee was happy to share his new way to find sweet stuff with his friends.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a polite boy named Tim. He liked to play with his toys. One day, Tim found a toy weapon in his room. It was a sword. Tim was very happy.
Tim played with his new weapon all day. He pretended to be a brave knight. He fought dragons and monsters. But then, he heard a scream from outside.

Tim ran outside to see what was wrong. He saw a little girl who was scared of a big bug. Tim used his toy weapon to scare the bug away. The girl said "thank you" and they became friends. They played together with the toy sword and had a great day.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the woods near her house. One day, she saw a lumber on the ground. She wanted to step on it, but her mom told her not to because it could hurt her feet.

Lily was sad because she really wanted to step on the lumber. But then she remembered that her mom said she would be happy if she listened to her. So, Lily decided not to step on the lumber and instead, she went to play with her friends.

Later that day, Lily's mom told her how proud she was of her for making the right choice. Lily felt happy and proud too. She learned that sometimes it's better to listen to grown-ups because they know what's best for us.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a flower. The flower was small and green. One day, the flower started to grow bigger and bigger. It was so big that it bloomed! The flower was now very pretty and colorful.

One day, a little girl was playing outside. She saw the flower and thought it was beautiful. She wanted to pick it, but her mommy said no. Instead, her mommy showed her how to give the flower some water so it could keep blooming.

Later that day, the little girl took a bath. She used her favorite shampoo that smelled like strawberries. After her bath, she brushed her hair and went to bed. It was a dark night, but she wasn't scared because she knew the flower was still blooming outside.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys and his dog, Max. One day, Timmy's mom gave him some scissors to cut some paper. Timmy was happy because he loved to cut things. But his mom warned him to be careful with the scissors.

Timmy started cutting the paper and he heard a strange noise. It was Max, who had gotten his tail caught in the scissors! Timmy quickly put down the scissors and helped Max. He was scared that he had hurt his best friend.

From that day on, Timmy was more careful with the scissors. He learned that it was important to be safe when using things that could hurt others. Timmy felt cheerful knowing that he had helped Max and learned an important lesson.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a young boy named Timmy. Timmy loved going to the park with his mom and dad. He would run around and play with his friends on the swings and slides.
One day, Timmy's mom forgot to supply him with sunscreen before they went to the park. Timmy didn't want to stop playing to put on sunscreen, so he kept playing in the sun.

Unfortunately, Timmy got a bad sunburn and had to go to the hospital. He was very sad and in a lot of pain. Timmy learned that it's important to always wear sunscreen and to listen to his parents when they supply him with things to keep him safe.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her friends. One day, as they were walking in the park, Lily saw a stick on the ground. She picked it up and started to play with it.

Suddenly, a dog appeared out of nowhere. Lily was scared because she had never seen this dog before. The dog barked loudly and ran towards her. Lily was so scared that she didn't know what to do. But then, the dog stopped and wagged its tail. Lily realized that the dog just wanted to play.

Lily threw the stick for the dog to fetch. The dog ran after it and brought it back to her. Lily was so happy that she wanted to give the dog a big hug. But the dog didn't like hugs and instead, it bit her hand. Lily was embarrassed because all her friends saw what happened. From that day on, Lily learned to be careful when playing with dogs.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a big gorilla who lived in a jungle. He was very obedient and always listened to his mommy gorilla. One day, he was feeling very thirsty and went to the river to drink some water. But the river was too far away and he was tired. Just then, a kind monkey came by and offered to bring him some water. The gorilla was very happy and said thank you to the monkey. From that day on, the gorilla and the monkey became good friends and played together in the jungle. The end.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her friends. One day, she saw a rag on the ground. It was dirty and torn. Lily wanted to throw it away, but her mom told her to pick it up and bring it inside.
Lily didn't want to touch the rag because it was yucky, but her mom said that it was important to help clean up. So, she came back outside with a pair of gloves on and picked up the rag.

When she brought the rag inside, her mom washed it and it became clean again. Lily learned that even though something may seem dirty or useless, it can still be useful if you take care of it. She felt happy that she helped her mom and learned something new.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He loved to play with his toy cars and make them zoom around the room. One day, Timmy's mom took him to a big building called a museum. Timmy saw lots of cool things like big bones and shiny rocks. He liked the museum a lot.

But then, Timmy saw a man who couldn't hear anything. His mom told him the man was deaf, which meant he couldn't hear. Timmy felt sad for the man and wanted to help him. So, Timmy took out one of his toy cars and made it zoom around in front of the man. The man smiled and clapped his hands.

From that day on, Timmy always brought a toy car with him whenever he went to the museum. He liked to make them zoom around for the deaf man and make him smile. And Timmy learned that even though someone couldn't hear, they could still have fun and be happy.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a tooth that was wiggly and ready to come out. One day, she was playing with her friend, Timmy, when he accidentally knocked her tooth out. Lily started to cry because it hurt.
Timmy said, "I'm sorry, Lily. Please forgive me."
Lily calmed down a little and said, "It's okay, Timmy. I forgive you."
But later that night, Lily's tooth started to hurt even more. Her parents took her to the dentist, but it was too late. The dentist said they couldn't save the tooth and it had to be taken out.
Lily was very sad and upset. She wished she could go back in time and not play with Timmy that day. But she knew that she had already forgiven him and it wasn't his fault.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in her garden and look at the pretty flowers. One day, she saw a big yellow butterfly fluttering around. It was so pretty that she followed it around the garden.

As she followed the butterfly, she saw a little bird sitting on a branch. The bird was singing a peaceful song. Lily stopped to listen to the bird's song and felt very calm. She realized that even though the butterfly was beautiful, the peaceful song of the bird made her feel even happier.

From that day on, Lily loved to look at the flowers and listen to the birds in her garden. She found that it brought her a lot of peace and happiness. And every time she saw a yellow butterfly, she remembered the peaceful feeling she had when she listened to the little bird's song.

chapters.title: Once upon a time a little…
p: Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to the park with her mommy. She saw a big, red slide and asked her mommy if she could ride it. Her mommy said yes and helped Lily climb up the ladder to the top of the slide.

Lily was so excited to ride down the slide, but then she saw a boy at the bottom who looked embarrassed. She asked him a question, "Are you okay?" The boy said he was fine, but Lily could tell he was embarrassed because his face turned red.

Lily rode down the slide and when she got to the bottom, she saw why the boy was embarrassed. He had accidentally dropped his ice cream cone and it had landed on his shirt. Lily felt bad for him and offered to share her own ice cream with him. The boy was happy and they became friends. From that day on, Lily always made sure to ask people if they were okay and to share her treats with them.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was sick and had to go to the hospital. There, she met a nice nurse who gave her medicine and made her feel better. Lily liked the nurse because she was kind.

One day, Lily was feeling better and wanted to play. She saw other kids playing and wanted to join in, but she couldn't run and jump like them. This made her frustrated. But then, she saw the other kids clapping and decided to join in. She clapped her hands and felt happy.

The nurse saw Lily clapping and smiled. She was happy to see Lily feeling better and having fun. From then on, Lily would often clap with the other kids and the nurse would join in too. They all became good friends and had fun together.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a man who loved to climb. He climbed high up on the mountains and looked at the number of trees and birds below. He felt happy when he was up high. One day, he saw a little girl who was lost. The man climbed down and helped her find her way home. The little girl was happy and hugged the man. From that day on, the man climbed not just for himself, but to help others too.
